edits.old: DP-08 is not in this story's pattern set: the capability area and the right are declared per operation and the access guard is a service-template capability, so the check is stated here and not built here.
edits.new: DP-08 is not in this story's pattern set: the capability area and the right are declared per operation and the access guard is a service-template capability, so the check is stated here and not built here. The rwb-access authorise check on API-S9-002 requires right C for the operation; the check's identifier is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S9-E6034-APP-6).

Names in this section that the Logical Data Model v9 and Data Classification v5 do not hold as fields or entities: `decision_record` is the library object of DP-03, whose fields are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S9-E6034-APP-7); `soft_recovery` is a placement type value of R-WO-30, not a field; `recovery_log` is a retired element named only in section 17 and has no field here.

Placement ownership (GAP-1854): S7 decides the post charge-off treatment under R-WO-29 and posts the recovery after charge-off; this service issues and tracks the placement instruction under R-WO-30 and holds the panel, the terms and the recall. The placement requirement traces to FEAT-PRM-06 of rwb-partner.

Fee ownership (GAP-3048): the fee calculation of R-WO-37 is FEAT-PRM-07 of rwb-partner and belongs to split slice RWB-S9-E6035-APP. This story does not calculate the fee and writes the fee reference to the decision record only. DP-04, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-16 are dependencies the plan does not hold; the fee ownership question is raised to the solution architect before the baseline tag.

**No personal data.**
